messages:
sara_m: Hi team / quick weird billing issue. I legally changed my last name in Feb and updated HR, but my insurer portal still shows my old last name on the digital ID. Went to ER over the weekend and they billed under my new legal name. Carrier now says 'member not found' and denied the claim. I paid $420 at discharge. Any advice on getting this reprocessed?

maya_peopleops: Sorry that happened @sara_m. Which plan are you on? Also did you already submit the name change docs to People Ops?

sara_m: I'm on Redwood Standard PPO. I submitted the name change form + marriage certificate to payroll on 2026-02-10 and HR confirmed it updated in our system. I don't see the update on the carrier site though.

ben_benefits: Common situation. Carrier sync can lag. Steps we usually follow: 
1) Get the ER itemized bill + proof of payment (you have receipt). 
2) Request a replacement/updated ID card from the carrier showing the corrected name. 
3) Ask the hospital billing to re-submit the claim with the correct member ID (they can attach a cover note that the member's name was updated after registration). 
4) If the hospital already received a denial, submit a member appeal including: marriage cert/name change docs, HR confirmation email, itemized bill, proof of payment, and the updated ID.

sara_m: Hospital billing said they used the name the patient gave at registration (which was my new name) and that re-billing is possible but they want a signed authorization from me to update the patient info.

maya_peopleops: I can draft the authorization form for you to sign and send to the hospital. Also I can request the carrier to issue an updated digital card ASAP; sometimes they can push a PDF within 24 hrs if it's a verified HR change. Want me to do both?

sara_m: Yes please -- the hospital said if they don't get the corrected info they may send to collections. I want to avoid that.

ben_benefits: I'll also prepare an appeal cover letter you can submit to the carrier if re-bill doesn't happen. Template below you can copy and sign.

ben_benefits: ```
To: Claims Department
Re: Claim denial for Date of Service: 2026-05-09 (Patient: Sara M.)
Member ID: XXXXXX--- (on file)
Claim #: (if available)

I am submitting documentation to correct an administrative member name mismatch that caused the denial. My name was legally changed (marriage certificate attached) and HR at Redwood Inference updated my employer records on 2026-02-10. The provider initially submitted the claim under my new legal name at registration, but the carrier's member record still reflected my previous last name at the time of adjudication.
Please accept the attached documentation (marriage certificate, HR confirmation, itemized facility bill, and proof of payment) and reprocess the claim under my membership. The member paid $420 in full at the time of service. I request that the carrier place any collection activity on hold while this administrative correction is reviewed.

Sincerely,
Sara M.
```

ryan_finance: If the hospital starts collections we can provisionally reimburse the $420 after you upload the receipt to Expensify with tag "health-advance". Finance will require the itemized bill and a short note. We'll recover funds if carrier reimburses later.

carrier_bot: [automated] Carrier guidance: For member demographic updates that cause denials, submit the following to claims.help@carrier.example with "Name Correction / Reprocessing" in the subject: 1) marriage certificate or legal name change document, 2) employer HR confirmation email, 3) itemized bill, 4) proof of payment, and 5) signed authorization if provider requests re-billing. Typical reprocessing time: 7-45 days. Collections hold requests are evaluated on case-by-case basis. Link: https://carrier.example/member-update

maya_peopleops: I'll DM you the authorization form and request the updated PDF card from the carrier right now. @ben_benefits can you DM the appeal template as a Word/PDF?

ben_benefits: DMing the appeal template now. Also I'll open a carrier liaison ticket once you DM me the documents so I can escalate and request a collections hold.

sara_m: Thank you all. I appreciate the quick help. I'll upload the receipt to Expensify for a potential advance and DM the docs to @ben_benefits. I'll update this thread after the hospital re-bills or the carrier responds. :pray:
